profile.name: Brandon Miner
profile.title: Data Scientist
profile.tagline: Building data systems and ML products end-to-end.

spotlight.name: Case Management System
spotlight.description: HIPAA-aligned case management platform that replaces legacy Zoho workflows with a normalized client hub, audit logging, and automated data entry for Safe Passages
bullets: Refactored a legacy Zoho Creator case management system into a normalized client-hub architecture, converting subform-based records into standalone forms keyed on a permanent Client ID and migrating historical data with Deluge batch scripts.

Built HIPAA-aligned safeguards into the app: field-level ePHI/PII tagging and encryption, granular team-based permissions, and a custom audit log across create, update, delete, search, and enrollment events that flags deletes and cross-program enrollment.

Automated the end-to-end data workflow as a data pipeline, replacing manual Excel lookups and copy-paste entry required of every member of an 8+ person team. Search pages with exact and fuzzy (2-of-3) matching on name and date of birth prevent duplicate client records and prefill downstream forms.

Digitized a paper-based grant program (HHIP) into Zoho forms with conditional show/hide workflows, award-letter tracking, and file-upload document checklists, creating a structured, auditable record where none existed.
Authored a documentation library (architecture, design rationale, and technical build guides) so future team members can maintain the system after the AmeriCorps term ends.

projects.name: Expanded Learning Program Attendance Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: cross-platform attendance data pipeline and Zoho Analytics dashboard that consolidates Expanded Learning program records for Safe Passages
bullets: Automated attendance data collection by building Playwright (Python) scripts to replace manual downloads from the America Learns platform, eliminating roughly [X hours/week] of manual work and reducing entry and export errors.

Designed a cross-platform data pipeline that syncs attendance data from multiple sources into Zoho Analytics as a single source of truth, applying relational database normalization (e.g., linking school-date keys to school and date tables) to keep records consistent across [N schools/programs].

Built interactive attendance dashboards and reports in Zoho Analytics, surfacing trends and patterns by school and date, and added program-level summary statistics so leadership can monitor [N sites/participants] without requesting ad hoc pulls.

projects.name: Body-worn Camera Compliance Tracking System
projects.description: self-hosted full-stack platform that ingests, stores, retrieves, and processes large batches of body-worn camera video for compliance review
bullets: Ingested video data from a variety of sources into a single source of truth.
Stored the video data in a scalable and efficient manner.
Retrieved the video data from the single source of truth.
Processed the video data into a usable format.
Built a dashboard to visualize the video data and identify trends and patterns.
Refactored a legacy Zoho Creator case management system, normalizing client data and converting the app into a HIPAA Compliant data system.
Automated the end-to-end data workflow as a data pipeline, eliminating manual data entry previously required of every member of an 8+ person team.
Redesigned the bi-weekly survey with tuned questions to shorten completion time while preserving data quality; deployed it through the required legacy system to 30+ AmeriCorps members.
Refactored legacy code to replace a poorly suited software choice with Ray, which fits the project's software and data pipeline more precisely.
Conducted distribution analysis to identify optimal strata for post-stratification of the golden evaluation dataset.

Owned end-to-end delivery of a production ML inference platform (Python, FastAPI, MySQL, Docker) deployed directly on client hardware, from requirements gathering through deployment, eliminating 300+ hours of manual review per monthly cycle.

Embedded with non-technical stakeholders to translate operational needs into a GPU-accelerated ETL & inference pipeline using FFmpeg & Whisper ASR, processing 600+ videos per month with zero cloud dependency.

Architected & shipped a multi-stage NLP classification system combining LLM-assisted auto-labeling, iterative fine-tuning, & structured output parsing, delivering audit-ready signals directly to end-users.
Deployed the full ML stack on a private-server FastAPI backend with a React.js web frontend, enabling non-technical civil rights investigators to run inference without engineering support.
Led a cross-functional team of 4 analysts to build data pipelines & deliver analytical products to government stakeholders, translating messy public datasets into actionable policy insights.

Designed & deployed an end-to-end data standardization pipeline combining iterative web scraping & text normalization; applied regression modeling to find that each 1% reduction in police staffing was associated with a 19.7% increase in police wages, and presented findings to county officials.

Applied mixed-effects regression with VIF-based multicollinearity reduction to regional homelessness expenditure data, surfacing high-impact interventions to guide resource allocation for program leadership.
